# Depiction Usage

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:DepictionUsage`](gmeow-DepictionUsage.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/DepictionUsage>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/images`](../../slices/images.md)

A reified, context-dependent depiction of an entity by an image — an observation in the universal claim stack: an entity ([`depictionSubject`](../properties/gmeow-depictionSubject.md)) is shown in a given image ([`depictionImage`](../properties/gmeow-depictionImage.md)), in a particular context ([`depictionContext`](../properties/gmeow-depictionContext.md)), by or among a particular audience ([`depictionAudience`](../properties/gmeow-depictionAudience.md)), over a period ([`depictionInterval`](../properties/gmeow-depictionInterval.md)), asserted by an authority ([`depictionAuthority`](../properties/gmeow-depictionAuthority.md)). Perspectival — a usage is whoever's, never a global fact — so it carries no notion of a preferred or canonical depiction. Mint one [`DepictionUsage`](gmeow-DepictionUsage.md) per (entity, image, context) tuple; its period is carried by [`gmeow:depictionInterval`](../properties/gmeow-depictionInterval.md) or by [`validFrom`](../properties/gmeow-validFrom.md)/validUntil on the statement.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Observation`](gmeow-Observation.md), [`gufo:Relator`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-relator)

Use [`gmeow:DepictionUsage`](gmeow-DepictionUsage.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Observation`](gmeow-Observation.md), [`gufo:Relator`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-relator). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
